title: Your swing
notFound: This swing could not be found.
noVideo: Video not stored – showing the skeleton only.

quality.title: Not reliably detectable
quality.intro: The video is not clear enough for a reliable diagnosis. We show what we saw, but no faults and no score.

tips.t1: Whole body in the picture – from the head to the feet, with some space around.
tips.t2: Phone on a stand at hip height, not hand-held.
tips.t3: Good light from the front or the side, no bright sky behind you.
tips.t4: Face-on: camera in front of you. Down-the-line: camera behind you, looking at the target.
tips.t5: Use slow motion or 60 fps if your phone offers it.

issue.no_person: No person was found in the video.
issue.body_cut_off: Head or feet are outside the picture.
issue.low_visibility: Important joints were hard to see (light, clothing, background).
issue.low_fps: Frame rate below 30 fps – tempo and impact are uncertain.
issue.too_short: The clip does not contain a full swing.
issue.no_swing_found: No swing was found in the clip.
issue.camera_moving: The camera moved during the swing.
issue.too_far: You are too small in the picture – move the camera closer.
issue.mirrored_suspected: The movement does not match the chosen handedness.
issue.club_not_found: The club could not be found in the picture – club values are estimated or missing.

noTotal.coverage: Not enough measured for a total score – film down-the-line for the shaft positions.

reason.view: not measurable from this camera view

tempo.fast: Your backswing is quick compared to your downswing – take it back more calmly.
tempo.slow: Your downswing is slow compared to your backswing – let it accelerate.
